from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
import torch

model_name = "Qwen/Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct" # 阿里通义千问(支持中文)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_name, torch_dtype=torch.float16, device_map="auto"
)

messages = [
 {"role": "system", "content": "你是一个有用的 AI 助手。"},
 {"role": "user", "content": "请用三句话解释什么是 Transformer?"},
]
text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False,
                                      add_generation_prompt=True)
可直接用 apply_chat_template(..., tokenize=True, return_tensors="pt")；若保留字符串步骤，则按模型规则传 add_special_tokens=False 并核对编码。

with torch.no_grad():
    output_ids = model.generate(
 **inputs, max_new_tokens=300, temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9,
        do_sample=True, repetition_penalty=1.1,
        pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
 )

new_tokens = output_ids[0][inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]:]
response = tokenizer.decode(new_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)
print(response)
